modifications: Defined a model-neutral host-side checkpoint_publication_refusal protocol for compact recurrent and ring-state implementations.
Preserved the existing speculation, rollback, staged PLE and QSA/MTP transaction guards behind the shared protocol.
Required self-MTP checkpoint donation to prove a committed target and draft graph before choosing descriptor COW or deepcopy, so a safety refusal cannot become a deepcopy fallback.
